title: Engineering Hiring Sync - Q3 Intake
summary: Engineering Hiring Sync - Q3 Intake was held on 30 July 2026 with Ayesha Rauf, Hina Shah, Sana Malik and Danish Iqbal. We agreed to prioritise the mid level backend role first and start the QA automation role in September. We decided to drop the agency for this round and post directly on the university boards and LinkedIn. I'll set up the LinkedIn job posting for the backend role by Monday. I'll review the backend candidate pipeline every Tuesday and share a shortlist with Sana each week. The meeting produced 2 recorded decisions and 6 action items.
